newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'shita Elec says no change to HK, China business.
newsitem.headline: M'shita Elec says no change to HK, China business.

text.p: Japan's consumer electronics giant Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Tuesday that its business policy in China and Hong Kong would not change after Hong Kong's return to China.
Britain handed Hong Kong back to China at midnight (1600 GMT) on Monday after more than 150 years of colonial rule.

"There will be no change in our business policy in China and Hong Kong. We would like to increase use of Hong Kong's global financial and distribution mechanisms in the future," president Yoichi Morishita said in a statement.
The Osaka-based company currently runs three production units, one sales unit and a distribution unit in Hong Kong and a total 34 units, including joint ventures, in China.

"The business environment in Hong Kong will not change greatly in a short period of time due to its return to China. We hope Hong Kong will continue to maintain its mechanisms, which are free, transparent and have few restrictions," Morishita said.
